description: UrbanFireXDT implements the simulation component of a digital twin for integrated renewable-energy systems. It loads prepared input data, simulates units and components, applies rule-based or optimisation controls and exports scenario metrics. The provider is University of Würzburg / DigiSWM contributors. Coverage: The software is generic, not a measured geographic dataset. Spatial detail and simulation periods are supplied by the user. Access: The public source repository provides documentation and installation instructions. Source archives and dependencies were not downloaded or run. Licence and cost: The README distinguishes MIT code from CC-BY-ND terms for documentation logos. External input data are separate. Limitations: The repository describes an updated implementation and several method publications. It contains the simulation component, not every data-preparation or deployed digital-twin service. For simulation it supports urban multi-energy scenario and control analysis. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers UrbanFireXDT.
